rover_mobility.label: Rover mobility
tests: Drive a prototype rover across slopes like the target's and log wheel slip
Train hazard detection on crater rims and blocky ground
Plan traverses using only orbital-resolution maps, then check them on the ground

ice_prospecting.label: Ice prospecting
tests: Field-test ground-penetrating radar over buried ice
Rehearse drilling and sample handling in frozen ground
Check thermal models of where ice survives near the surface

dust_mitigation.label: Dust mitigation
tests: Expose seals, joints, and solar panels to dust storms
Measure dust build-up on optics over a season
Test cleaning methods for suits and hardware

base_construction.label: Base construction
tests: Level and stabilise a landing pad on similar slopes
Cure construction material made from local loose rock and dust
Load-test structures through large day-night temperature swings

wind_erosion_science.label: Wind-erosion science
tests: Measure yardang shapes and erosion rates and compare them with Martian ones
Calibrate rover cameras on wind-carved layered rock
Compare dune and ripple migration with orbital change detection
